learn.title: Financial Awareness & Scam Protection
learn.subtitle: Official guidance, verified helplines, and instant scam-message checker for India.
learn.scam_checker_subtitle: Paste suspicious SMS, WhatsApp message, or email text. Input is evaluated heuristically and never stored or logged.
learn.scam_checker_placeholder: Paste suspicious message text here (e.g. electricity disconnect threat, fake KYC update, prize notice)...
learn.scam_checker_clean: No scam signals detected in this message. Always verify through official banking channels.
learn.scam_checker_suspicious: Caution: Scam signals detected in this message!
learn.scam_checker_disclaimer: Heuristic check, not a verdict. Never share OTP or PIN.
scam_advice.stay_vigilant: Stay vigilant. Never share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone.
scam_advice.official_channels: Verify any unexpected financial communications through the official app or website.
scam_advice.verify_source: Do not call numbers provided in SMS or unverified emails. Contact customer care directly.
scam_advice.never_share_credentials: Remember: Bank officials and genuine merchants will never ask for PIN, OTP, or CVV.
scam_advice.do_not_click: Do not click links or download APK files from unknown or shortened URLs.
scam_advice.do_not_pay: Do not make payments or approve collect requests under urgency or threats.
scam_advice.report_1930: Report suspected financial cybercrime immediately to national helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
